title: Mask of DOOM
description: RIP to the Illest Villain! Rename a Netherite helmet to "Mask of DOOM" to obtain this ruby-studded glory.
body:
I plan to revisit this texture soon enough.
To obtain the Mask of DOOM, rename a Netherite helmet to just that - "Mask of DOOM".

Caution! Only for use in villainous ways...
